brief.title: Outpatient appointment scheduling
business_goals: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.
Improve slot utilization by automatically freeing cancelled slots.
Reduce phone line congestion and prevent inappropriate A&E visits due to booking difficulties.

stakeholders.name: Dr. Fiona Marsh
concerns: Double-bookings happen most weeks across nine clinics.
Patients need online booking, rescheduling, and cancellation.
Patient records must pull from NHS Spine for NHS number verification.
Patient data must stay within the UK (UK GDPR).
Need an audit trail of patient record views (CQC requirement).
Seven years of appointment and attendance history retention is required.

stakeholders.name: Tom Reilly
concerns: Online booking should show real-time availability per clinician, across multiple sites.
Cancellations within 24 hours should automatically free slots.
Need to flag persistent late-cancellers for follow-up by reception.

stakeholders.name: Ben Coulson
concerns: High number of no-shows, especially for first appointments.
System should send SMS and email reminders 48 hours and 2 hours before appointments.
Patients should be able to request a specific clinician.
System should allow booking 'next available' for some clinic types (e.g., physiotherapy).
Phone lines get backed up, leading patients to A&E.

stakeholders.name: Aisha Patel
concerns: Appointment data needs two-way sync with EMIS practice management system.
Targeting under 3 seconds to load available slots, even during peak times.

constraints: Budget capped at £180,000 for this phase.
Must go live before the new financial year starts in April.
Patient records must pull from NHS Spine lookup to confirm NHS number.
Patient data must stay within the UK (UK GDPR).
System requires an audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when (CQC inspection requirement).
Appointment data needs two-way synchronization with EMIS.
At least seven years of appointment and attendance history must be retained (NHS guidance).
out_of_scope: Referrals from GPs (these will continue through the existing e-Referral Service process).
Booking for new patients (project is only for patient self-service booking for existing patients).
open_questions: What is the precise start date of the new financial year in April?
What is the definition of an 'existing patient' for self-service booking?
What are the current metrics for no-shows, late cancellations, and phone line congestion to establish a baseline for success measurement?

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to book appointments online.
requirements.rationale: To provide patient self-service and reduce phone line congestion.
requirements.evidence: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to reschedule appointments online.
requirements.rationale: To provide patient self-service and reduce phone line congestion.
requirements.evidence: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to cancel appointments online.
requirements.rationale: To provide patient self-service, reduce phone line congestion, and improve slot utilization.
requirements.evidence: Patients need to be able to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments online.

requirements.statement: The system shall display real-time appointment availability per clinician.
requirements.rationale: To provide accurate availability across multiple sites and prevent double-bookings.
requirements.evidence: Online booking should show real-time availability per clinician, not just per clinic — some of our consultants split time across two sites.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an SMS reminder 48 hours before an appointment.
requirements.rationale: To reduce the number of no-shows.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email reminder 48 hours before an appointment.
requirements.rationale: To reduce the number of no-shows.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an SMS reminder 2 hours before an appointment.
requirements.rationale: To reduce the number of no-shows.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email reminder 2 hours before an appointment.
requirements.rationale: To reduce the number of no-shows.
requirements.evidence: Ideally the system sends an SMS and email reminder 48 hours before the appointment, and again 2 hours before.

requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with NHS Spine to verify the patient's NHS number.
requirements.rationale: To comply with trust requirements for patient identity verification.
requirements.evidence: Any patient record has to pull from our NHS Spine lookup to confirm the NHS number before the first appointment is confirmed — we can't have a booking without a verified NHS number, that's a hard requirement from the trust.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent the confirmation of a first appointment without a verified NHS number.
requirements.rationale: To comply with trust requirements for patient identity verification.
requirements.evidence: Any patient record has to pull from our NHS Spine lookup to confirm the NHS number before the first appointment is confirmed — we can't have a booking without a verified NHS number, that's a hard requirement from the trust.

requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize appointment data with EMIS.
requirements.rationale: To maintain data consistency with the existing practice management system.
requirements.evidence: Appointment data needs to sync with EMIS both ways — a booking made online should show in EMIS, and if a clinician blocks time in EMIS, it should disappear from the online slots.

requirements.statement: The system shall reflect online bookings in EMIS.
requirements.rationale: To ensure EMIS is up-to-date with online bookings.
requirements.evidence: Appointment data needs to sync with EMIS both ways — a booking made online should show in EMIS, and if a clinician blocks time in EMIS, it should disappear from the online slots.

requirements.statement: The system shall remove slots from online availability when a clinician blocks time in EMIS.
requirements.rationale: To prevent double-bookings and ensure real-time availability accuracy.
requirements.evidence: Appointment data needs to sync with EMIS both ways — a booking made online should show in EMIS, and if a clinician blocks time in EMIS, it should disappear from the online slots.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically free a cancelled appointment slot if the cancellation occurs within 24 hours of the appointment.
requirements.rationale: To improve slot utilization and reduce wasted appointment times.
requirements.evidence: Cancellations within 24 hours of the appointment should free the slot for another patient automatically

requirements.statement: The system shall flag patients who cancel appointments within 24 hours.
requirements.rationale: To allow reception to follow up with persistent late-cancellers.
requirements.evidence: we also want to flag those patients so reception can follow up — persistent late-cancellers are a real problem for us.

requirements.statement: The system shall ensure all patient data is stored within the UK.
requirements.rationale: To comply with UK GDPR regulations.
requirements.evidence: Under UK GDPR, patient data has to stay within the UK

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain an audit trail of all patient record views, including the viewer and timestamp.
requirements.rationale: To comply with CQC inspection requirements.
requirements.evidence: we need an audit trail of who viewed which patient record and when — that's something our last CQC inspection specifically asked about.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to request a specific clinician.
requirements.rationale: To accommodate patient preferences.
requirements.evidence: We'd like patients to be able to request a specific clinician

requirements.statement: The system shall allow patients to book the "next available" appointment for specified clinic types.
requirements.rationale: To provide flexibility for patients and optimize clinic slot utilization for certain services.
requirements.evidence: for some clinic types like physiotherapy, ideally the system should also let them just book "next available" instead.

requirements.statement: The system shall load available appointment slots within 3 seconds.
requirements.rationale: To ensure a responsive user experience, especially during peak times.
requirements.evidence: On performance, we're targeting under 3 seconds to load the available slots for any given clinic, even during the Monday morning rush when everyone's trying to book at once.

requirements.statement: The system shall not handle referrals from GPs.
requirements.rationale: This functionality is out of scope for the current project.
requirements.evidence: Referrals from GPs are out of scope for this project

requirements.statement: The system shall only allow self-service booking for existing patients.
requirements.rationale: Booking for new patients is out of scope for the current project.
requirements.evidence: we're only building patient self-service booking for existing patients.

requirements.statement: The system shall retain appointment and attendance history for at least seven years.
requirements.rationale: To comply with NHS records retention guidance.
requirements.evidence: We need at least seven years of appointment and attendance history retained, in line with NHS records retention guidance.

requirements.statement: The system shall be deployed before the new financial year starts in April.
requirements.rationale: To meet project timeline constraints.
requirements.evidence: this needs to go live before the new financial year starts in April

requirements.statement: The system development and deployment costs shall not exceed £180,000 for this phase.
requirements.rationale: To adhere to the allocated project budget.
requirements.evidence: the board has capped the budget at £180,000 for this phase.

epics.title: Online Appointment Management
epics.goal: Enable patients to manage their appointments conveniently online, reducing administrative burden.

epics.title: Patient Identity & Data Compliance
epics.goal: Ensure patient data is handled securely, verified accurately, and compliant with healthcare regulations.

epics.title: Core System Integrations
epics.goal: Seamlessly integrate with existing healthcare systems to maintain data consistency and operational efficiency.

epics.title: Appointment Reminders & Slot Optimization
epics.goal: Reduce no-shows, optimize clinic schedules, and improve patient communication through automated reminders.

stories.title: View Clinician Availability
stories.i_want: to view available appointment slots for a clinician
stories.so_that: I can choose a suitable time to book.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and select a clinician
acceptance_criteria.when: I request to view their availability
acceptance_criteria.then: a list of available slots for that clinician is displayed.

acceptance_criteria.when: no slots are available for the selected clinician
acceptance_criteria.then: a message indicating no availability is displayed.

acceptance_criteria.when: the system loads the slots
acceptance_criteria.then: the slots are displayed within 3 seconds.

stories.title: Book an Appointment
stories.i_want: to book an available appointment slot
stories.so_that: I can secure my appointment with a clinician.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have selected an available slot
acceptance_criteria.when: I confirm the booking
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is registered in the system.

acceptance_criteria.when: I view my upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: the newly booked appointment is listed.

stories.title: Reschedule an Appointment
stories.i_want: to reschedule an existing appointment
stories.so_that: I can change my appointment time without calling the clinic.

acceptance_criteria.when: I select to reschedule and choose a new available slot
acceptance_criteria.then: my original appointment is cancelled and the new slot is booked.

acceptance_criteria.when: I view my upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is displayed with the new date and time.

stories.title: Cancel an Appointment
stories.i_want: to cancel an upcoming appointment
stories.so_that: I can free up the slot and avoid a no-show.

acceptance_criteria.when: I select to cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is marked as cancelled in the system.

acceptance_criteria.when: I view my upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: the cancelled appointment is no longer listed as upcoming.

stories.title: Filter Appointments by Clinician
stories.i_want: to filter appointment availability by a specific clinician
stories.so_that: I can book an appointment with my preferred doctor.

acceptance_criteria.when: I select a specific clinician from a list
acceptance_criteria.then: only appointments for that clinician are displayed.

stories.title: Book Next Available Appointment by Type
stories.i_want: to find the next available appointment for a specific clinic type (e.g., General Practice)
stories.so_that: I can book the earliest possible slot without browsing multiple clinicians.

acceptance_criteria.when: I select a clinic type (e.g., "GP")
acceptance_criteria.then: the earliest available slot across all relevant clinicians is displayed.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing the next available slot for a clinic type
acceptance_criteria.when: I book it
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is confirmed for that slot.

stories.title: Request NHS Number Verification from NHS Spine
stories.i_want: to send a patient's NHS number to NHS Spine for verification and receive a status
stories.so_that: I can confirm the validity of the NHS number.

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient provides an NHS number during registration or first booking
acceptance_criteria.when: the system queries NHS Spine for verification
acceptance_criteria.then: a verification status (e.g., "verified", "not found", "error") is returned from NHS Spine.

stories.notes: Reduced scope to focus on sending the request and receiving a basic status, deferring full processing and linking to subsequent stories.

stories.title: Enforce NHS Number Verification for First Booking
stories.i_want: to be prompted to verify my NHS number for my first appointment
stories.so_that: my identity can be confirmed before booking.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a new patient attempting to book my first appointment
acceptance_criteria.when: I try to confirm the booking without a verified NHS number
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays a message requiring NHS number verification and prevents booking confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.when: my NHS number is successfully verified
acceptance_criteria.then: I am allowed to proceed with booking my first appointment, and the system stores my verified NHS number.

stories.notes: This story assumes the capability to verify an NHS number (e.g., S-007) exists. It focuses on enforcing the verification step in the patient booking flow.

stories.title: Configure UK Data Residency for Patient Data Storage
stories.i_want: to configure data storage to be exclusively within the UK
stories.so_that: we comply with data residency regulations and patient data is protected.

acceptance_criteria.given: a new data storage instance is provisioned for patient data
acceptance_criteria.when: the instance's region is checked via system tools
acceptance_criteria.then: the instance's region is confirmed to be within the UK.

acceptance_criteria.when: the storage location is queried via system tools
acceptance_criteria.then: the reported storage location is within the UK.

stories.notes: Rephrased as an actionable configuration story with immediately verifiable acceptance criteria.

stories.title: Log Patient Record Access
stories.i_want: to log all access to patient records, including who viewed them and when
stories.so_that: we maintain an auditable trail for compliance and security.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views a patient's record
acceptance_criteria.when: the view occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: an audit entry is created containing the user ID, patient ID, and timestamp.

acceptance_criteria.when: an administrator queries the log for a specific patient
acceptance_criteria.then: all view events for that patient are displayed.

stories.title: Configure Data Retention Policy for Appointment History
stories.i_want: to configure the system to retain appointment and attendance history for at least seven years
stories.so_that: we comply with medical record retention policies.

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment record is created with a timestamp
acceptance_criteria.when: a simulated data retention check is performed for a record 6 years old
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is identified as not eligible for deletion.

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment record is created with a timestamp
acceptance_criteria.when: a simulated data retention check is performed for a record 7 years and 1 day old
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is identified as eligible for deletion.

stories.notes: Rephrased as an actionable configuration story with immediately verifiable acceptance criteria.

stories.title: Synchronize Online Bookings to EMIS
stories.i_want: to push online appointment bookings, reschedules, and cancellations to EMIS
stories.so_that: EMIS accurately reflects the online appointment schedule.

acceptance_criteria.given: a new appointment is booked online
acceptance_criteria.when: the booking is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is created in EMIS within 5 minutes.

acceptance_criteria.when: the reschedule is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment's time/date is updated in EMIS within 5 minutes.

acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is marked as cancelled in EMIS within 5 minutes.

stories.notes: Scope reduced to focus on one-way synchronization (online to EMIS) to make the story smaller and more manageable.

stories.title: Reflect EMIS Clinician Blocked Time Online
stories.i_want: to reflect clinician blocked time from EMIS in the online availability
stories.so_that: patients cannot book slots that are unavailable in EMIS.

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinician blocks time in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.when: the system synchronizes with EMIS
acceptance_criteria.then: those slots are removed from online availability.

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinician unblocks time in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.when: the system synchronizes with EMIS
acceptance_criteria.then: those slots are displayed as available for online booking.

stories.title: Display Real-time Appointment Availability
stories.i_want: to see real-time appointment availability
stories.so_that: I can book a slot that is genuinely free.

acceptance_criteria.when: another patient books a displayed slot
acceptance_criteria.then: that slot is immediately removed from my view or marked as unavailable.

acceptance_criteria.when: a clinician blocks time in EMIS
acceptance_criteria.then: that slot is removed from my view within 30 seconds.

stories.title: Send 48-Hour SMS Appointment Reminder
stories.i_want: to send an SMS reminder 48 hours before an appointment
stories.so_that: patients are reminded of their upcoming visit.

acceptance_criteria.when: it is 48 hours before the appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: an SMS reminder is sent to the patient's registered mobile number.

acceptance_criteria.when: the patient has opted out of SMS notifications
acceptance_criteria.then: no SMS is sent to that patient.

stories.title: Send 48-Hour Email Appointment Reminder
stories.i_want: to send an email reminder 48 hours before an appointment
stories.so_that: patients are reminded of their upcoming visit.

acceptance_criteria.when: it is 48 hours before the appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: an email reminder is sent to the patient's registered email address.

acceptance_criteria.when: the patient has opted out of email notifications
acceptance_criteria.then: no email is sent to that patient.

stories.title: Send 2-Hour SMS Appointment Reminder
stories.i_want: to send an SMS reminder 2 hours before an appointment
stories.so_that: patients receive a final prompt to attend.

acceptance_criteria.when: it is 2 hours before the appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: an SMS reminder is sent to the patient's registered mobile number.

acceptance_criteria.when: the patient has opted out of SMS notifications
acceptance_criteria.then: no SMS is sent to that patient.

stories.title: Send 2-Hour Email Appointment Reminder
stories.i_want: to send an email reminder 2 hours before an appointment
stories.so_that: patients receive a final prompt to attend.

acceptance_criteria.when: it is 2 hours before the appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: an email reminder is sent to the patient's registered email address.

acceptance_criteria.when: the patient has opted out of email notifications
acceptance_criteria.then: no email is sent to that patient.

stories.title: Automatically Free Cancelled Appointment Slots
stories.i_want: to automatically free up cancelled appointment slots if cancelled within 24 hours
stories.so_that: other patients can book them and clinic utilization is maximized.

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment is cancelled within 24 hours of its scheduled time
acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: the slot is immediately marked as available online.

stories.title: Flag Patients with Late Cancellations
stories.i_want: to flag patients who cancel appointments within 24 hours of the scheduled time
stories.so_that: clinicians can identify potential repeat offenders for no-shows or late cancellations.

acceptance_criteria.when: the cancellation occurs within 24 hours of the appointment time
acceptance_criteria.then: the patient's record is flagged with a 'late cancellation' indicator.

acceptance_criteria.given: a patient's record is flagged with a late cancellation
acceptance_criteria.when: a clinician views the patient's history
acceptance_criteria.then: the late cancellation flag is visible.

gaps.description: Tom Reilly's concern specifies that real-time availability should be shown 'across multiple sites', but R-004 only mentions 'per clinician' without explicitly covering multiple sites. Given the 'nine clinics' mentioned in the brief, this is a significant omission.
gaps.suggested_question: Does R-004 'The system shall display real-time appointment availability per clinician' implicitly cover all clinics/sites, or do we need to explicitly state that availability must be shown across multiple sites?

gaps.description: A core business goal is to 'Reduce or eliminate double-bookings', and Dr. Fiona Marsh explicitly states 'Double-bookings happen most weeks'. While requirements like R-004 (real-time availability) and EMIS sync (R-011, R-012, R-013) contribute to this, there is no explicit requirement stating that the system *shall prevent* double-bookings.
related_ids: Business Goal: Reduce or eliminate double-bookings
gaps.suggested_question: While real-time availability and EMIS sync help, is there a specific requirement needed to explicitly state that the system must prevent double-bookings, or are the existing requirements considered sufficient to achieve this goal?

gaps.description: Tom Reilly's concern mentions the need to 'flag persistent late-cancellers'. R-015 only covers flagging *any* patient who cancels within 24 hours, but does not specify a mechanism for tracking or identifying 'persistent' behavior.
gaps.suggested_question: R-015 flags any patient who cancels within 24 hours. Does 'persistent late-cancellers' require a more advanced tracking mechanism (e.g., X cancellations in Y months) or is simple flagging sufficient for initial follow-up?

gaps.description: R-024 states the system must be deployed 'before the new financial year starts in April'. The precise start date of the new financial year is an open question in the brief and is critical for project timeline compliance.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the precise start date of the new financial year in April that the system must be deployed before?

gaps.description: R-022 states the system shall only allow self-service booking for 'existing patients'. The definition of an 'existing patient' is an open question in the brief and is crucial for defining the system's user base.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the precise definition of an 'existing patient' for the purpose of self-service booking?

gaps.description: Ben Coulson's concern highlights 'High number of no-shows, especially for first appointments'. While general reminders (R-005 to R-008) address no-shows, there are no specific requirements or features targeting the unique challenges of no-shows for first appointments.
gaps.suggested_question: Are the general appointment reminders sufficient for reducing no-shows for first appointments, or is there a need for specific features or different reminder strategies for these critical initial appointments?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for most stated business goals and stakeholder concerns, particularly around online booking, rescheduling, cancellations, and appointment reminders. Key non-functional requirements like data residency, audit trails, and EMIS synchronization are also addressed. However, there are notable gaps concerning the explicit prevention of double-bookings, the scope of real-time availability across multiple sites, and the precise definition of critical project parameters like 'existing patient' and the 'new financial year' start date. Addressing these ambiguities and uncovered goals will be crucial for successful project delivery and meeting all stakeholder expectations.
